snippet.description:
CRUD Operations for Class 12 Computer Science Chapter 4 explained step-by-step for Intermediate (FSc Part 2) students following the Pakistani curriculum.

In this video, you'll learn all four fundamental database operations: Create, Read, Update, and Delete. CRUD operations form the backbone of database management systems and are essential for any student preparing for FBISE, Punjab Board, Sindh Board, or any other Pakistani examination board.

What You'll Learn:
- Understanding Create operations and inserting data into databases
- Read/Retrieve operations to fetch and display records
- Update operations to modify existing data
- Delete operations to remove records safely
- Practical examples following PCTB textbook standards
- Real-world applications of CRUD in database systems
- SQL queries and database manipulation techniques

This lesson is designed for Class 12 students (2nd Year/Intermediate) studying Computer Science under the National Curriculum of Pakistan. Whether you're preparing for board exams, school tests, or want to strengthen your programming fundamentals, this comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know about CRUD operations.

Why CRUD Matters:
Understanding CRUD operations is critical for database management, web development, and software engineering. These operations appear frequently in board exams and practical examinations across all Pakistani boards including Federal Board, BISE Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, and other provincial boards.

Perfect for:
- FSc Part 2 students
- HSSC Computer Science learners
- Board exam preparation
- Programming beginners
- Database fundamentals

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and comment with any questions. Share this video with your classmates to help them master CRUD operations!

snippet.description:
Learn Complementary and Compound Events in Class 9 Maths Chapter 13 Exercise 13.1 with our step-by-step tutorial. This video is designed for Matric students preparing for FBISE, Punjab Board (BISE Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad, Gujranwala), Sindh Board, KPK, and all other Pakistani examination boards using PCTB and National Curriculum textbooks.

Complementary events and compound events are fundamental concepts in probability theory that help you understand how multiple outcomes interact in a sample space. In this lesson, we break down the definitions, explore real-world examples, and work through every question in Exercise 13.1 with clear, easy-to-follow solutions.

What you will learn:
- Definition and properties of complementary events
- How to find the probability of complementary events
- Understanding compound events and their relationships
- Solving Exercise 13.1 problems step-by-step
- Practical applications in probability calculations

Whether you are studying for Matric final exams, working through your SSC mathematics curriculum, or strengthening your fundamentals in probability, this tutorial provides the detailed explanation you need. Our approach covers the PCTB syllabus requirements and aligns with all major Pakistani boards.
